# Tissue GTEx expression

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
setwd("")
wd<-("")
```

```{r}
xlsxfile <- file.path(wd,"GTExTissues.xlsx")
sampleTable <- read_excel(xlsxfile)
View(sampleTable)
table(sampleTable$sampleID)
dfsamples<-data.frame(sampleTable)
str(dfsamples)
table(dfsamples$sampleID, dfsamples$tissue)
table(dfsamples$tissue)
#table(dfsamples$subject)
```

```{r}
dim(sampleTable)
```

#RNA-Seq workflow
This workflow is based on quant files from Salmon
We define work directory where we have the data:

```{r}
dir<-("")
```

```{r}
samples <- data.frame(sampleTable)
samples
```

```{r}
load("ddsGTExtissues.RData")
```

DESeq2

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
dds$tissue
dds$tissue <- factor(dds$tissue)
dds$tissue
colData(dds)
```

```{r}
dds$adipose <- factor(dds$adipose)
dds$adrenal <- factor(dds$adrenal)
dds$bladder <- factor(dds$bladder)
dds$blood <- factor(dds$blood)

dds$liver <- factor(dds$liver)
dds$lung <- factor(dds$lung)
dds$muscle <- factor(dds$muscle)
dds$nerve <- factor(dds$nerve)
dds$ovary <- factor(dds$ovary)
dds$pancreas <- factor(dds$pancreas)
dds$pitutary <- factor(dds$pitutary)

dds$spleen <- factor(dds$spleen)
```

```{r}
save(dds, file="ddsGTExtissues.RData")
```
```{r}
load("ddsGTExtissues.RData")
```

##Prepare ENSEMBL annotation to the res tables.

```{r}
library(biomaRt)
```

```{r}
listMarts()
ensembl_hs_mart <- useMart(biomart="ensembl", dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
ensembl_df <- getBM(attributes=c("ensembl_gene_id","description","ensembl_transcript_id","hgnc_symbol", "entrezgene_trans_name","chromosome_name", "band", "entrezgene_id", "external_transcript_name"), mart=ensembl_hs_mart)
```

```{r}
write.csv(ensembl_df, "gtex_ensembl_annotation.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
save(ensembl_df, file="ensembl_df.RData")
```

## August 2026
#### GENE level analysis

```{r}
colData(dds)
colnames(colData(dds))
```

From a `dds` object.

```{r GENE level}
ddsAD <- DESeqDataSet(dds, design = ~ adipose)
```

```{r adjust rownames}
rownames(res)
row.names(res)[1:10]
res$GENE<-row.names(res)
rownames(res)<- gsub("\\..*", "", res$GENE)
rownames(res)[1:10]
resOrdered <- res[order(res$padj),]
head(resOrdered)
```

```{r}
my_genes = row.names(resOrdered)
my_genes_ann = ensembl_df[match(my_genes, ensembl_df$ensembl_gene_id),]
colnames(my_genes_ann)
my_genes_ann
```

```{r}
res2 <- cbind(resOrdered, my_genes_ann[match(rownames(resOrdered), my_genes_ann$ensembl_gene_id), ,drop=FALSE])
resOrdered <- res2[order(res2$padj),]
resSig <- subset(resOrdered, padj < 0.05)
head(resSig)
```

Normalised counts with gene IDs
Annotate `res` to become `res2`

```{r res2}
res2 <- cbind(res, my_genes_ann[match(res$geneID, my_genes_ann$ensembl_gene_id), ,drop=FALSE])

resOrdered <- res2[order(res2$padj),]
resSig <- subset(resOrdered, padj < 0.05)
write.csv(as.data.frame(resSig), file="Tissue205FDR005salmon.csv")
write.csv(as.data.frame(resOrdered), file="Tissue205SalmonresOrdered.csv")
```

```{r res2}
gdds2 <- gdds
rowData(gdds2) <- cbind(rowData(gdds), my_genes_ann[match(rowData(gdds)$gene_id, my_genes_ann$ensembl_gene_id), ,drop=FALSE])
rownames(gdds2)[1:4]
rownames(gdds2)<-rowData(gdds2)$hgnc_symbol
rownames(gdds2)[1:4]

resOrdered <- res2[order(res2$padj),]
resSig <- subset(resOrdered, padj < 0.05)

write.csv(as.data.frame(resSig), file="Tissue250deseq2ensembl.csv")
write.csv(as.data.frame(resOrdered), file="Tissue250deseq2ensemblresOrdered.csv")
```

```{r}
save(gdds2, file="gDDS2_SEtissuesRNAseqGE.RData")
```

```{r}
normcodata<-counts(gdds2, normalized=T)
write.table(as.data.frame(normcodata), file="NormCountdata_250TissuesGeneId.txt", sep="\t")
```
